sentences.text: This review examines how neurodegenerative diseases might be treated by targeting the TrkB/BDNF signaling pathway.
It summarizes small molecules that have been tested and shown to protect nerve cells by altering the function of this system.
Under normal conditions, neurotrophins support cell survival by promoting the growth of nerve extensions, the creation of new neurons, structural changes, and long-term strengthening of connections.
The authors note that a lack of neurotrophic signaling is an area of neurodegenerative disease that has not been studied as much as other factors.
